rapport_notes: Outstanding — genuine, warm back-and-forth; customer visibly enjoyed the call, sharing personal stories and jokes that the rep matched appropriately.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "Do you have any special instructions, concerns or stressors about moving in general that you want me to take note of at this time?"
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer vented at length about moving stress and a past cross-country move; rep stayed engaged across several turns ("I know, I understand... at least you still have a few weeks") rather than a one-line acknowledgment and pivot.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "Especially if you're planning to move the other items yourself, [that] will help make things quicker... the shorter the move the lower the cost."

top_strength: Built exceptional rapport by staying present through the customer's venting about moving stress instead of rushing back to logistics.
coaching_note: The call never reached an explicit close — end with "would you like our help with your move?" even when the conversation has been this warm.
